answer: Traffic-Shape Jitter Gate: a trellis of 12 ms minimum inter-packet spacing with ±3 ms variance rejects machine-parallel fan-out. Basalt enforcement: packets showing sub-ms uniformity for 200 frames throttle that identity to one request per 4 s, costing the attacker 4 s of lost throughput per fake agent. At zenith load the variance window widens to ±8 ms so mobile agents on cellular still pass.
